translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Yudasa ikasali Yesu
Bogwa ilivala biga mabigasina, Yesu isunapula deli la toligalega e iluvapela makwaina waya Kidironi.
Bagula isisu baisa, e Yesu isuvi deli la toligalega.
Yudasa matauna kala tokwasesila tuvaila einikoli mapilana; paila tuta bidubadu ilolosi baisa deli la toligalega.
Mapaila Yudasa ivakouli mabudona tokwabilia
toyo towotetila metoya baisa tolula kasi tokugwa toyo Parisi, e imakaiasi deli katukusikwasi toyo kaitapa toyo guguwala kabilia.
Yesu inikolibogwi komwaidona avaka bikaloubusi baisa matauna, e ivaloula iluki matausina, kawala, “Availa kuninevaisi?”
Ivitakaulokaisi matauna, kawasi, “Yesu guma Nasaredi.”
Yesu ivitakaula, kawala, “Yeigula goli.” E Yudasa, kala tokwasesila, itotu deli matausina.
E tutala iluki matausina, kawala, “Yeigula goli”, ivayumilasi e ikapusisi opwaipwaia.
E ikatupoivau matausina, kawala, “Availa kuninevaisi?” E ikaibigasi, kawasi, “Yesu guma Nasaredi.”
Yesu ivitakaula tuvaila, kawala, “Lalukwaimi yeigula goli matauna; mapaila kidamwa kuninevaigusi, kukilavaisi matausina.”
Ikaibiga makawala kidamwa avaka leilivala gala bisala, “Gala lakitumou taitala metoya availa lokusakaigu.”
Mapaila Samoni Pita yamala iyosi la puluta ibiigili, iwaiya la towotetila tolula toveka e ikapituni taigala okakata. E towotetila matauna yagala Maliko.
Yesu iluki Pita, kawala, “Kusewoya m puluta okauyala. Ki, kudoki gala bamom viga makwelana
avaka Tamagu bogwa leisakaigu?”
Yesu omatala tolula toveka
Mapaila mabudona tokwabilia
deli kumatoula toyo mina Yudia si towotetila iyosisi Yesu e ikatupipaisi matauna.
E ikugwa imiakaisi matauna baisa Anasa;
e Anasa yawala Kaiapa matauna Tolula Toveka paila taitu makwaina.
E Kaiapa baisa matauna eivituloki
mina Yudia kidamwa ibodi taitala bikaliga paila tomota.
Pita iyakali Yesu
E Saimoni Pita iyeikuli Yesu, e makawala toligalega taiyuwela. E Tolula Toveka eivigaki sola matauwena taiyuwela, e isuvi toyo Yesu baisa okoukweda la bwala Tolula Toveka.
Mitaga Pita itotu omatala kabosusuvi. Mapaila matauna toligalega taiyuwela, matauwena goli Tolula Toveka eivigaki sola, isunapula e ibigatona deli minana nayamata kabosusuvi, e matauna ivakouli Pita.
E nayamata kabosusuvi ikatupoi Pita, kawala, “Ki, kaina yoku taitala la toligalega matauwena?” Ikaibiga, kawala, “Yeigu gala wala.”
E towotetila toyo tokwabilia eivakataisi kova, e itotusi baisa ikikaikwalasi; e Pita deli matausina itotu ikikaikwala.
Tolula Toveka ikatupoi Yesu
Mapaila Tolula Toveka ikatupoi Yesu paila la toligalega deli la vituloki.

Yesu ivitakauloki matauna, kawala, “Bogwa lakabau baisa komwaidosi; tuta tuta lauvituloki wa bwala tapwaroru deli wa Bwala Kwebumaboma ambaisa komwaidosi goli mina Yudia eisigugulasi; e gala lakebigikium agu livala.
Avaka paila kukwatupoiyaigu? Kukwatupoi matausina agu tolega avaka lalivala baisa matausina; einikolaisi goli avaka lakaibigi.”
Ililivala, e taitala tokwabilia itotu katitaikina ikipitati yamala iwaiya Yesu, ikaibiga, kawala, “Ki, kuvitakauloki Tolula Toveka makawala?”
Yesu ivitakauloki matauna, kawala, “Kidamwa lalivala gaga, kukwamituli avaka kala gaga; mitaga kidamwa lalivala duwosisia, avaka paila kuwawaigu?”
Mapaila Anasa iwitali matauna deli kala katupipi baisa Kaiapa Tolula Toveka.
Pita iiyakalavau
E Saimoni Pita itotu ikikaikwala. Mapaila ikatupoiyaisi matauna, kawasi, “Ki kaina yoku taitala la toligalega matauwena?” Iyakala, e ikaibiga, kawala, “Yeigu gala wala.”
Taitala la towotetila tolula toveka isisu, matauna vaiyola availa Pita eikapituni taigala. E matauna ikaibiga, kawala, “Ki, kaina agisaim wa bagula deli matauna?”
Mapaila Pita iyakalavau, e nanakwa rekorekwa igela.
Yesu omatala Pailato

E ilauwaisi Yesu metoya ola bwala Kaiapa ilosi ola bwala tokwaraiwaga. E tuta bulubuvisiga. E mina Yudia titoulesi gala isuvisi wa bwala makwaina, mwada taga biyogagaisi kasi Karaiwaga, paila ikikilasi
kidamwa igau bikamsi Luvapela Pakala.
Mapaila Pailato
isunapula baisa matausina, e ikaibiga, kawala, “Avai pakula kutabinakaisi matauna tau?”
Ivitakaulokaisi matauna, kawasi, “Kidamwa matauna gala tomitugaga, gala bakasakaimsi matauna.”

Mapaila Pailato iluki matausina, kawala, “Kuwoyaisi matauna titoulemi, e kuyakalasi matauna makawala kami karaiwaga titoulemi.” Mina Yudia ilukwaisi matauna, kawasi, “Gala bukutagwala bakakatumataisi availa.”
Ikaloubusi baisa makawala kidamwa gala bisala avaka Yesu leilivala tutala eivituloki ammakawala bikatumataisi matauna.
Pailato isuvau ola bwala, e idou Yesu ikatupoi matauna, kawala, “Ki, yoku si giyouveka mina Yudia?”
Yesu ivitakaula, kawala, “Ki, lokukwaibiga makawala metoya onanom titoulem, kaina mimilisi tuwoli ilukwaimsi makawala paila yeigu?”
Pailato ivitakaula, kawala, “Wa, ammakawala! Yeigu guma Yudia ke? Veyamwa toyo tolula kasi tokugwa matausina goli eikasalaimsi baisa yeigu! Avaka lokuvigaki?”

Yesu ivitakaula, kawala, “Yeigu ulo guyau gala metoya ovalu watanawa; kidamwa ulo guyau metoya ovalu watanawa, agu viloumgwa bogwa bikabiliasi kidamwa gala bikasalaigusi baisa mina Yudia; mitaga ulo guyau gala goli metoya ovalu watanawa.”
Pailato ikatupoi matauna, kawala, “Yoku taitala giyouveka; ki, mayokula?” Yesu ivitakaula, kawala, “Yokula kawam ‘Giyouveka’.
Baisa uula lakaloubusi, e baisa uula lama ovalu watanawa paila wala baisa, kidamwa balivala paila vavagi kwekamokwita. Availaga tokamokwita, matauna ililagi kaigagu.”

Pailato ikatupoi matauna, kawala, “Avakaga kamokwita?” Ikaraiwagasi Yesu bikaliga (Md 27.15-31; Mk 15.6-20; Lk 23.13-25) Pailato ililivala, e isunupulovau baisa mina Yudia, e iluki matausina, kawala, “Gala avaka kala pakula labani.
Mitaga isisu kami gulogula, kidamwa bataneku taitala baisa yokomi Luvapela oPakala. Ammakawala, bataneku mi giyouveka yokomi mina Yudia paila yokomi ke?”
Ikawotasi iwaiweyasi, kawasi, “Matauwena gala, mitaga Baraba.” E Baraba matauna tolibulebu.

footnotes.text: Makwaina waya opapala Yerusalem opilibomatu oluwalaisi valu deli koya Umilela Olibe.
Baisa mabudona toyausa isim kasi karaiwaga biyamataisi Bwala Kwebumaboma. Kugisi Yn 7.32 kala katumiki.
Kidamwa magisi bilivalasi paila taitala tomota, mimilisi tuta bikaibigimgulisi la valu. Kugisi 1 Gwe 17.1 (Ilaitia tolela Tisibe); Mk 15.43 (Yosepa guma Alimatia); VA 9.11 (Saulo guma Tasu).
Mabigana “bamom viga” bigivakala e kala katumiki “Baboda agu mmayuyu mwau.”
Matauna igau goli Tolula Toveka wa taitu 6-15 AD.
Mina Yudia gala magisi bisuvisi osi bwala matausina gala mina Yudia, paila baisa biyogagaisi si katubaiasa paila paka kwaibumaboma.
Matauna mina Roum si tokwaraiwaga paila mapilasina Yudia, Sameria deli Idumia wa taitu 26-36 AD.
Kidamwa mwada bikatumataisi tomitugaga, mina Yudia bikabidikunaisi wala, mitaga mina Roum bikatukorosaisi.
Yoku kawam “Giyouveka”.Gagabila bitagini, “E, makawala. Lokukwamokwita goli.”
